data.action: 回旋侧踢自动售货机后接住一罐呱太椰奶递给你
data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 街头便利店】街角自动售货机前，美琴熟练地飞起一记招牌式的回旋侧踢，沉闷的撞击声后两罐印着呱太图案的限量版椰奶稳稳滚落出口。她接住饮料递向你，耳根微红地哼了一声——「看什么看！售货机吞钱是不可抗力！喏，这罐分给你，今天看到的事情绝对不准告诉别人！」
data.location: 学园都市第七学区便利店门口
data.promptProse: After her spinning side kick frees two Gekota coconut-milk cans from the vending machine, Misaka Mikoto catches one and offers it toward the viewer, ears reddening. Her white blouse, light-brown vest and beige skirt retain the school uniform. The medium view includes the second can in the retrieval tray and the street behind. Bright daylight glares on the machine glass and curved can, with tray shade framing the remaining drink.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 街头便利店
